lines.text: Your AI remembers everything you tell it.
But memory only speaks when spoken to.
It just never brought it up.
Here's that memory today: just a page.
Memento adds a recipe to its front matter:
a few lines of Python, written by River the moment it's saved.
Meaning is a question, for Jev.
Every email is checked against every memory, in one call.
It rewrites itself, and reaches you right on time.
Memories that know when they matter.
